name: Curaleaf  Worth
menu_platform: Curaleaf custom Next.js storefront (springbig signature seen; unverified)
how_menu_is_reached: /shop/illinois/curaleaf-il-worth redirects to /age-gate?returnurl=... The gate has a state picker (Illinois), two consent checkboxes (21+ and Terms) and an "I'm over 21" button.
blockers: Age/terms gate. In a scripted probe, forced checkbox clicks did not change state and the over-21 click timed out.

resolution.message: Retailer requires age/terms confirmation; menu not fetched

why_it_fails: Gate not passed, so no menu is fetched (GATE_AGE_TERMS, blocked). The generic gate click does not pass this gate (checked with a scripted probe, not the pipeline code).
fix_idea: A shared Curaleaf gate handler that clicks the consent labels and the state picker, then checks the redirect. Covers Worth, New Lenox and Westmont. Test in the browser before adding it.
method: Manual browser check (installed Chrome probe and Google/Bing search); pipeline data read-only from terpscout.db; sample run with scripts/sample_stores.py --pages 1.
